Problem Statement:
Write a program to iterate both lists simultaneously and display items from list1 in original order and items from list2 in reverse order.
Input Description:
First line of input consists of size of the list1 and list 2.
Second & thrid line of input consist of elements of list1 and list2
Output Description:
Consist of list1 in original order and items from list2 in reverse order
Explanation:
Self Explanatory
Sample Input:
2 2
1 2
3 4
Sample Output:
1 4
2 3
